PluginData.Author: OwendB1
PluginData.Tooltip: Live KOTH scores, a dedicated Discord channel through Quasar's bot, and backed-up score resets.
PluginData.Description: Integrates the King of the Hill Workshop mod (2388326362) with Quasar. Adds a full-width KOTH page with per-server expansion panels, automatically updated faction scores, and capture announcements through Quasar's existing Discord bot, player score commands, and authorized standalone score resets with verified XML backups. Includes its own Magnetar companion, which also blocks client-sent plugin reset packets in the supported mod. Keep the Workshop mod installed in your world. Configure the KOTH channel on the plugin page; no separate bot or webhook is required. Nexus and Quasar cluster resets are refused. Requires Quasar 1.6.0.54 or newer. Restart Quasar and managed game servers after installation. Source is AGPL-3.0-only. See the repository for compatibility limits and live acceptance checks.
